termsP1: You must be 18 or older to use DeepMatch. Abuse, fraud, and harassment are prohibited; we may suspend or delete accounts that violate these terms.
termsP2: Block and report are always free. Premium is optional (web: bank transfer; iOS: Apple IAP).
privacyP1: DeepMatch (DatingVN) collects email, dating profile data, messages, and technical data needed to operate matching, chat, and safety features.
privacyP2: Data is stored on Supabase (ap-southeast-1). We do not sell personal data. You can export or request account deletion in the app (Me → Delete account) or contact support.
privacyP3: Payments: web may use bank transfer; iOS uses Apple In-App Purchase under Apple’s terms.
deleteStep1: Open the DeepMatch app and sign in.
deleteStep3: Confirm DELETE. Your profile is hidden and the Auth account is deleted.
deleteWebPrompt: Already signed in on web? Type DELETE and confirm.
